Initialize cloud provider configuration

Usage:
  erun cloud init [command]

Available Commands:
  aws         Set up an AWS cloud provider alias

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for init

Global Flags:
      --debug-output    Capture this environment's full erun trace to ~/.erun/<tenant>/<env>/trace.log from now on (persists the env's debugoutput setting; the desktop's Diagnostics console reads it).
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.

Use "erun cloud init [command] --help" for more information about a command.
